commit_message: Bridge Native 2D events to Project Rust
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Bridges dedicated Native 2D collision/trigger transitions and Sprite Animation frame events into the Project Rust host event surface. The existing 3D Collision stream remains unchanged; Collision2d is additive and uses generation-checked entity handles, while sprite frame events reuse the typed Animation entity/name payload. Producer generations prevent duplicate host-log insertion across subscribers.
